body.x: The content industry has been emerging as a key industry in the Korean economy. Smart content, especially, is taking center stage. In conjunction with this phenomenon, the Korean government is making a sustained effort to activate the Smart content industry. The Smart Content Center is the core organization for this action.

As a part of an effort to support companies’ overseas expansion, the Smart Content Center will select some eligible companies and participate in the world’s biggest fair for electronic products - CES 2014.

The Smart Content Center was established in May 2012 and it includes around 50 different companies with outstanding technologies and ideas. The role of the Smart Content Center is supporting these companies in all aspects, from their projects and development to international business, so that they can be successful in the global market.

The Smart Content Center is providing offices to the companies and not only that, they also fund development and production, and build networks for investment, distribution and cooperation with other companies. They also help them participate in several business related fairs to help them expand their business overseas.

The companies which are participating in 2014’s CES include, ‘Pison contents’; provider of the first Korean global online music distribution platform ‘MusicSpray’, ‘Hisshow’; the provider of the bible animation ‘Hisshowbible’, ‘Publstdio’; provider of an educational interactive appbook, ‘Kamon Ltd’; filming system developer with 360 Degree Movie, ’CODELINE’; developer of ‘easy&elly’.
More details are available at the booth of the Smart Content Center in CES 2014 (Venetian Ballroom, 2F, Booth# 70231).
